name: Teaching Dimension / Average Teaching Dimension
details: The maximum of the individual minimum teaching-set sizes is at least their arithmetic mean.
proof: For each concept $h$, its minimum teaching-set size is at most the maximum teaching-set size. Averaging these inequalities over $h$ gives $\mathrm{TD}\ge\mathrm{TS}_{\mathrm{avg}}$.
witness_verification: For the family #classes/singletons_plus_empty_set with n>=4, the established endpoint values or bounds, in parameter order, are $n$ and $\frac{2n}{n+1}$. The first parameter divided by one plus the second tends to infinity as n tends to infinity, ruling out every reverse affine-linear bound. See the database-owned value proofs for these two endpoints.
